isolation: Use per-task stack and synthetic data only; do not send messages or contact real applicants

scenarios.title: Scope and permissions
scenarios.given: A clean implementation checkout and the baseline
scenarios.when: Review the release scope and call each privileged route as visitor, volunteer and operator
scenarios.then: Only the role matrix grants access; no deferred capability is presented as delivered; generated contracts implement this baseline
scenarios.method: Document review and API authorization matrix

scenarios.title: Stale updates and deletion
scenarios.given: Two staff clients share an ETag and a separate stone has an active hold
scenarios.when: Save from both clients; omit If-Match; attempt deletion of held and free stones
scenarios.then: First save succeeds, stale requests return 412, missing preconditions return 428, active hold returns 409; valid delete hides the stone and preserves tombstone/cleanup intent

scenarios.title: Responsive layout and focus
scenarios.given: Catalog/detail with chat open and filters/adoption modal available
scenarios.when: Exercise 320, 768 and 1440 px widths, 200% zoom, keyboard navigation and Escape and reduced motion
scenarios.then: No horizontal overflow or hidden focus; modal traps only when appropriate; chat respects inert background; cards and controls remain readable

scenarios.title: Upload validation and ownership
scenarios.given: Authorized staff plus a foreign staff session and visitors
scenarios.when: Upload supported files at 10 MiB and over, MIME/signature mismatch, corrupt/animated/oversized-pixel files and metadata-bearing image
scenarios.then: Only valid bounded decoded images accepted; metadata removed; private keys hidden; foreign draft returns 404; unauthorized upload returns 401/403
scenarios.method: File-security integration fixtures and authorization tests

scenarios.title: Staff queue privacy and abuse
scenarios.when: Use queue filters/actions; cross role boundaries; hit session/IP limits; advance retention clock
scenarios.then: Authorized private queue works; visitor cannot read contacts; 429 includes truthful delay; protection outage returns 503; terminal PII purged at 30 days and minimal audit removed at 90 days
scenarios.method: Staff browser charter, authorization and retention tests

scenarios.title: Write uncertainty and replay window
scenarios.given: Saved create/application/reindex outcomes and retained key markers
scenarios.when: Retry identical/changed payloads before 72 hours and after 72 hours; simulate lost commit acknowledgement
scenarios.then: Original result replays without new work; changed/expired-used keys return 409; uncertainty reconciled before a new mutation; no assumed rollback

scenarios.title: Semantic evidence and late changes
scenarios.given: Fixture with card support, type-only support, contradiction, missing vectors and more than five matches
scenarios.when: Search mixed wishes, then delete/reserve/change a selected stone before commit
scenarios.then: Hard filters precede limits; contradiction veto holds; bounded ranking/counts truthful; partial list not padded; one all-lost refresh maximum; no fabricated individual color
scenarios.method: Controlled semantic integration and real-model qualification

scenarios.title: Knowledge grounding and attribution
scenarios.given: Versioned factual and fictional passages including the source qualification
scenarios.when: Ask care, personality, ritual and a mixed selection question; open Sources
scenarios.then: Fiction explicitly labelled; individual claims supported; same-version citations resolve; no secret keys/scores; missing evidence acknowledged; deleted projection does not break retained citations
scenarios.method: Source parsing, independent answer rubric and browser disclosure checks

scenarios.title: Model bounds and valid fallback
scenarios.given: A checked selection and a knowledge-only turn under constrained budget/time
scenarios.when: Force malformed output, late provider failure, limit exhaustion and unknown usage
scenarios.then: Counters never reset; current input not truncated; only checked selection may template; knowledge failure remains error; no partial pair or unsafe late commit; reservations settle only reliable usage
scenarios.method: Controlled model/ledger tests and fixed-set assessment

scenarios.title: Generated contracts and security
scenarios.given: Generated OpenAPI JSON and YAML and every operation in section 10
scenarios.when: Compare schemas, headers, errors, roles, CSRF, Origin checks, ETags, session expiry and secret redaction
scenarios.then: Both formats are equivalent; all operations are documented; there is no competing handwritten contract; authorization and expiry are enforced; no secret or spoofed forwarded-IP identity is accepted

scenarios.title: Service objectives and restoration
scenarios.given: Declared reference hardware and the specified isolated load fixture
scenarios.when: Run the stated read, write and indexing samples and restore a catalog/object backup into a new environment
scenarios.then: Targets are met or the gate fails with measurements; model timing is not reported as non-model latency; restored catalog and images agree; logs contain no contacts or secrets
scenarios.method: Bounded load qualification and disaster-recovery exercise

scenarios.title: Static and architectural handoff
scenarios.given: A patch with known positive and negative DTO, layer and style fixtures
scenarios.when: Invoke the developer wrapper with valid code, a known violation, a missing report and an unapproved suppression
scenarios.then: Reports bind to exact content; violations or missing reports block handoff; semantic policies are not falsely claimed as PMD coverage; all relevant pins are verified
scenarios.method: Deterministic wrapper self-tests and architecture fixtures

scenarios.title: Environment loss during integration
scenarios.given: A requested batch with declared components and isolated endpoints
scenarios.when: Stop a required database, API or browser dependency between precheck and completion; change content after a passing run
scenarios.then: The batch starts only after every prerequisite passes; the watcher detects loss and marks BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT; changed content invalidates evidence; original application data is untouched

scenarios.title: Swarm to final gate
scenarios.given: Matching developer, test and browser evidence with independent reviews
scenarios.when: Evaluate all-pass, review-rejected, browser-not-run, Sonar-failed, stale-content and mock-only cases
scenarios.then: Only all required passes for the same content allow DONE; every other case blocks with a concrete reason; no board connector exists; browser-agent execution is not labelled human testing
scenarios.method: Deterministic gate decision matrix and evidence review

scenarios.title: Independent AI qualification
scenarios.given: A versioned 20-scenario, 28-turn fixture with revised source, fiction and broad-search oracles
scenarios.when: Collect original real-model results and controlled races under the declared quota
scenarios.then: All hard checks, at least 8/9 semantic and 10/12 ordinary-answer scenarios must pass; incomplete cases cannot pass; templates do not inflate quality; the source 2/9 and 0/12 results remain historical failures
scenarios.method: Fixed-set harness and independent acceptance review

implementation: Each browser-required ticket creates its own executable quality/e2e/<TASK-ID>/*.spec.ts suite for that ticket contribution; full scenarios are aggregated at release
